headline: EnQuest Sells UK Upstream Business to NEO NEXT+ for $960 Million
summary: EnQuest agreed to sell its North Sea oil and gas upstream operations in the United Kingdom to NEO NEXT+ in a transaction valued at $960 million.
why: UK North Sea assets are undergoing extensive consolidation driven by the energy transition and changes to British upstream windfall tax policies.

impacts.name: EnQuest
impacts.why: EnQuest monetises its mature UK upstream portfolio for $960 million, bolstering its balance sheet.
